item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera plucks a leaf from the tulsi plant growing in a pot at her home in Pune. She observes that the veins spread out from a thick middle vein and form a net-like pattern on both sides of it. What type of venation does this leaf show?

options.A: parallel venation, because all leaves have veins running side by side
options.B: reticulate venation, because the veins form a net-like pattern
options.C: parallel venation, because the leaf is small and thin
options.D: reticulate venation, because the leaf is green in colour
